featured_reviews.name: Sakshi Pawar
featured_reviews.review_text:
I am Kalpesh Pawar a student of St. Rocks High School.

My experience at St. Rocks High School has been wonderful and memorable. The teachers are supportive, friendly, and always motivate students to achieve their best. The school maintains a good balance between academics and extracurricular activities, which helps in overall personality development.

I have learned important values, built confidence, and created many unforgettable memories with my friends and teachers. I feel proud and grateful to be a part of this school, which has played a big role in shaping my future.

featured_reviews.name: Raahashree Thevar
featured_reviews.review_text:
"I am currently a student at St. Rock's High School, and my experience here has been wonderful. The teachers are incredibly supportive and have a unique way of explaining even the most difficult concepts so that every student in the class understands them clearly. They don't just teach from books; they make sure we truly grasp the logic behind what we learn.
Beyond academics, the school encourages us to participate in many social and extracurricular activities. These programs have helped us progress in our confidence and teamwork skills. It is an amazing school that focuses on both our studies and our overall growth as individuals."
"Every day at school feels like a new opportunity to grow, and I truly look forward to attending my classes because of the inspiring atmosphere here."

featured_reviews.name: Sanjay More
featured_reviews.review_text:
I Swayam More studying right now in St. Rocks school, feel proud to be a student at this school. The teachers are supportive, approachable, and always encourage us to do our best. They make learning interesting by connecting lessons to real-life examples, which helps me understand concepts more clearly.

The school environment is safe, friendly, and full of opportunities. From academics to sports and cultural activities, there’s always something to participate in. I especially enjoy the extracurricular programs, which allow me to explore my talents beyond the classroom.

The facilities, like the library, computer labs, and playgrounds, are well-maintained and accessible. What I appreciate most is how the school emphasizes discipline, respect, and teamwork, which makes us not only better students but also better individuals.

Overall, my school has given me confidence, knowledge, and unforgettable experiences. I’m grateful to be part of this community and would highly recommend it to anyone looking for a place to learn and grow.

featured_reviews.name: Lalita Singh
featured_reviews.review_text: I am writing this review to express by deep appreciation for the management and faculty at st.rock's. Their dedication to student welfare and disciplined learning is visible in every aspect of the school. As a mother, my biggest priority was finding a school where my child would feel both, safe and inspired. After our experience at St. Rock's High School, I can confidently say we found exactly that. What stands out most is the personal attention the teachers provide. They don't just focus on the toppers; they truly care about the progress of every student. The school strikes a wonderful balance between academic rigor and co-curricular activities, ensuring that children develop confidence and life skills alongside their studies.

name: JBCN International School Borivali
description:
JBCN International School, Borivali is an international school in Borivali offering Cambridge Primary, ICSE, Cambridge IGCSE, and Cambridge AS & A Levels from Pre-Primary to Grade XII. The campus serves families across Borivali, Kandivali, and Malad.
Ranked No. 1 in Mumbai (Zone E) by Mid-Day and among the Top 20 International Board Schools in India by Education Today, JBCN Borivali also holds the Sustainable Superstar award (GoSharpner UN SDGs). Facilities include a swimming pool, skating rink, sports courts, and science and computer labs. Through the EduCreative approach and dedicated counselling, learners progress to LSE, Cambridge, Carnegie Mellon, and NMIMS, with $13M+ in scholarships across the JBCN network.

owner_posts.post_text: At JBCN International School Borivali, three proven entry stages help families make the right move at the right time. Children between ages 3 and 5 join before academic pressure sets in, with play-based inquiry-led learning building a natural global outlook and strong early language skills from the very start. Around Grade 6, the transition becomes about independence: students learn to question, collaborate, and apply knowledge through projects, well ahead of board exam demands. For Borivali families focused on overseas universities, Grade 9 is the strategic entry point. IGCSE followed by the IB Diploma or A Levels ensures globally recognised credentials from senior school onward. Every stage is designed for a confident, supported start. Visit JBCN Borivali and speak with our admissions team today.

Aarav Lele, part of JBCN's High Achieving Learner cohort, has secured a spot in Stanford's Discrete Mathematics course, a programme with just a 5–8% acceptance rate open to grades 8–11 worldwide.

This is what makes JBCN the best international school in Mumbai with strong academics, expert mentoring, and a proven record of high university placements that open global doors for students year after year.

Our counselling team works with every student from early on, building profiles that stand out at the world's most selective institutions. The results speak for themselves.
Your child's future starts here.

Most parents use "preschool" and "pre-primary" interchangeably, but there's a big difference.

Preschool focuses on play and basic socialisation for toddlers (ages 2–3). Pre-Primary is a structured, curriculum-driven programme (ages 3–6) that builds school-readiness through language, numeracy, cognitive skills, and emotional development.

At JBCN Borivali, our Pre-Primary programme goes beyond daycare-style learning. With an internationally benchmarked curriculum, trained educators, and a child-centred approach, we prepare your little one for confident entry into formal schooling.

JBCN Pre-Primary Borivali offers,
- Holistic Development
- Internationally Benchmarked Curriculum
- Safe & Nurturing Environment
- iPropel Skill-Based Programme

We are so proud of our ICSE 2026 school topper, Om Sandeep Porwal, who scored an outstanding 99.60% and made the entire JBCN family cheer! The Class 10 results have been truly wonderful, with a 90.14% class average, a 100% pass rate, and 70% of learners scoring 90% and above. 

Om credits his success to consistency, balance, and his 5 P's: Perseverance, Positivity, Persistence, Patience and Passion. We are proud of every learner who worked hard and gave their best this season! Admissions for 2026-27 are now open. Come visit us and experience what JBCN Borivali is all about!

JBCN International School Mumbai's Class of 2026 has achieved outstanding university placement results across its Borivali, Parel, and Oshiwara campuses. A total of 131 learners secured 488 university offers and USD 6 million in scholarships from globally recognised institutions including Imperial College London, UCL, LSE, UC Berkeley, UCLA, University of Toronto, and University of Melbourne. Recognised among the top IB schools in Mumbai, JBCN offers IB Diploma, Cambridge A Levels, IGCSE, and ICSE pathways. For families looking for the best international schools in Mumbai, JBCN International School Borivali delivers consistent results, personalised university counselling, and proven global outcomes.
